newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 6.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- China's top leaders attend cremation of elder statesman Peng Zhen in Beijing
- Premier Li Peng visits Zambia, provides 50 million yuan interest free loan for Tanzania-Zambia railway
- Construction Bank gives loans for mortgages
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
CHINA SECURITIES
- China GDP seen growing 9.6 percent in first half
- Export tax rebates accelerate, completing 3.16 billion by end-March and April to see even faster payment
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China Agricultural Development Bank new loans down 500 million in first quarter compared with year-ago period
- Seminar on product and trade financing by state-owned enterprises held in Shenzhen
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Subsidiaries of foreign joint ventures to pay same income tax as parent comanies, says notice from State Taxation Administration
CHINA DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin voices sympathy for Iraqi people over sanctions in meeting with Iraq Deputy Prime Minister Tariq Aziz
- Fire crews on alert as forest fire in north China is tamed
- China to limit fishing to protect ocean resources
- Listing of Gezhouba Co this week to give support to Three Gorges dam project
- BMW signs contract to develop land in Beijing development zone
